title: Database Engineering (Complete)
description: A vendor-agnostic deep dive into how databases actually work: storage engines (B-tree vs LSM-tree), page layout & buffer pools, indexing internals, the ACID model & isolation anomalies, concurrency control (2PL, MVCC, OCC), write-ahead logging & crash recovery, query execution & optimization, replication (sync/async, leader-follower, multi-leader, quorum), partitioning & sharding, distributed consensus (Raft) & CAP/PACELC, and choosing among SQL / NoSQL / NewSQL / time-series / graph / vector / search engines.
